AMAV.name: American Avocet
field_marks: Black and white wings with bold pattern

AMOY.name: American Oystercatcher
field_marks: Yellow eye with red orbital ring

ANHI.name: Anhinga
field_marks: Often swims with only neck above water

AWPE.name: American White Pelican
field_marks: Massive white bird with black wing tips
Huge orange-yellow bill with throat pouch

BLSK.name: Black Skimmer
field_marks: Red and black bill with yellow tip

BRPE.name: Brown Pelican
field_marks: Flies in lines low over water

CAEG.name: Cattle Egret
field_marks: Often found in fields with cattle

DCCO.name: Double-crested Cormorant
field_marks: Swims low in water, dives for fish

GBHE.name: Great Blue Heron
field_marks: Black stripe over eye to plumes

HERG.name: Herring Gull
field_marks: Black wing tips with white spots

REEG WM.name: Reddish Egret White Morph
field_marks: Pink bill with black tip (KEY field mark)
Blue-gray legs (not black like Great Egret)

ROSP.name: Roseate Spoonbill
field_marks: Feeds by sweeping bill side to side

SNEG.name: Snowy Egret
field_marks: Black legs with yellow feet ("golden slippers")

WFIB.name: White-faced Ibis
field_marks: Dark chestnut body with metallic sheen

WOST.name: Wood Stork
field_marks: Soars on thermals with neck extended
